Overview

New Haven is a city in CT with a population of 130,000. Home of Yale University with a vibrant cultural scene, pizza heritage, and coastal location. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.9.
